text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein exchanges Ramadan congratulations with world kings and heads of state.
- Iraq-Jordan land transport company discusses ways of boosting Iraq-bound goods via Jordanian port of Aqaba.
- Iraq and Indonesia discuss cooperation in oil industries.
- Demonstration in U.S. Congress in support of Iraq in its fight against U.S. trade sanctions.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Volunteers wishing to join Saddam Commando Force are to report to branches of the ruling Baath party.
- Transport and communications minister meets U.A.E. official.
- British organisation demands lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Turkish personalities condemn presence of U.S. troops on Turkish territory.
